prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 33-year-old woman with straight dark hair, brown eyes and a round face sits on the floor of a modest animal-adoption room, meeting her new small puppy. The puppy rests its front paws on her knees and looks up at her; she smiles and gently supports its chest. Use soft window daylight, a simple blanket and believable small paws, distinct from human hands. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Square 1:1 gallery composition, with comfortable room around faces, hands and the complete action. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional composition and anatomy requirements: Exact 1:1 square photograph with one whole small tan-and-white puppy. Show the puppy side-on with exactly four anatomically believable legs: two front paws resting on her knees and two hind paws on the floor, with a natural spine, ears and tail. The woman's supporting hand touches the puppy's upper chest gently and remains clearly distinct from all canine paws. Her other hand rests on her own knee. Preserve the puppy's entire body inside the frame.
review: Reviewed full square photo: one dark-haired woman sits on the floor of an adoption room with one complete tan-and-white puppy. The puppy has two front paws on her knees and two hind paws on the blanket, a normal tail and coherent body. Her chest-supporting/scratching hand is distinct from canine paws and her other hand rests on her knee. Faces and hands look natural. PNG 1254x1254.
